_comment: Game spotlight Shorts (bot/world.py plan_game): name, Roblox link, pitch + facts read by the narrator; screenshots in assets/games/<id>/NN.jpg. Only published games with a url are used.

cloudbreak.name: Cloudbreak Couriers
cloudbreak.pitch: Glide between floating islands and deliver parcels for the skyport.
facts: Take courier jobs at Cloudbreak Skyport.
Glide through wind rings, updrafts and launch pads.
Deliver parcels, repair landmarks and rescue lost Cloudlings.
Earn Sky Tokens and Reputation to unlock new islands.
Co-op for up to 8 players.
Day and night cycle with lamps and fireflies.

listener.name: THE LISTENER
listener.pitch: Escape a night sanatorium from a monster that talks back.
facts: Co-op horror escape for 1 to 6 players.
Restore power: fuses, generator, boiler valves, keycard, gate.
The antlered monster hunts by sight and sound.
Type to it and it answers out loud.
It only finds you by what it sees or hears.
Hide in lockers and lure it with bottles.

skysunder.name: SkySunder
skysunder.pitch: Co-op sword combat against waves on pink sunset sky islands.
facts: Co-op wave combat for 1 to 5 players.
Fight the Hollow with sword combos and Blink Strike.
Wall-run, dash and ground pound between hits.
Spend shards at the Rift Forge on upgrades.

warlines.name: WarLines
warlines.pitch: Real-time territory war on a map of the real Earth.
facts: Up to 25 players per server, plus AI nations.
Send troops into neutral or enemy land.
Grow gold and troops, build, sail and nuke.
Ally with other nations, or betray them.
Win by holding 80 percent of the land.
Play the World map or generated islands.

outofframe.name: Out of Frame
outofframe.pitch: Hide from a giant camera before it takes the photo.
facts: Party hide-and-seek for 2 to 50 players.
The camera hears noise, turns, locks on and flashes.
Anyone visible in the photo is out.
Hide time shrinks with every photo taken.
Seven maps, including Classroom, Warehouse and Giant Bedroom.
Last player never photographed wins.
